EmailTemplate.subject: Your goodr wholesale account will be deactivated on {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Deactivation_Date__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.Name},
This is a formal notice that your goodr wholesale account, {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Store_Name__c}, is scheduled for deactivation on {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Deactivation_Date__c} due to 18 months of inactivity, per Section 22 of our Terms of Service.
Placing an order before that date will keep your account active with no interruption. If your account is deactivated, reactivation requires submitting a new Retailer Application, and approval is not guaranteed.
If you’d like help placing an order or have questions, please reply to this email or contact your account representative directly.
Best,
The goodr wholesale team
